note: Wikimedia Commons, “Lawrence of Rome by M.Dikarev (1897, Hermitage).jpg”; artist as recorded there: Mikhail Ivanovich Dikarev — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Titled “Lawrence of Rome” and described «Михаил Иванович Дикарёв. Архидьякон Лаврентий. 1897. Государственный Эрмитаж» — the archdeacon Lawrence, filed under “Icons of Saint Lawrence”. The office (архидьякон) and the city are both stated, which is what separates him from Lawrence of Kaluga on the same day. Commons describes it: Михаил Иванович Дикарёв. Архидьякон Лаврентий. 1897. Государственный Эрмитаж, инв. ЭРЖ-2514.
